value.body: A postgraduate diploma that trains graduates to translate between Hindi (or another Indian language) and English. It covers translation theory, terminology and hands-on practice with official, legal, technical, media and literary texts. Universities offer it in regular, part-time or distance mode, including open universities such as IGNOU.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree, usually with the languages involved studied at some level — check each university's rule. Admission is by graduation marks, a university entrance test, or direct enrolment for open-university programmes.

value.title: At a glance
items: It is a diploma, not a degree, and can be taken alongside an M.A. or a job.
For central Hindi translator posts filled through SSC, a translation diploma or certificate is one of the listed ways to meet eligibility, alongside a Master's — read the current notification.
Outside government, translation work exists in publishing, media subtitling and software localisation, often on a freelance basis.
